title: Instant Cashout Fee Schedule for External Debit Cards — Cartwise Shopper Payouts
content:
**Fee schedule note — Cartwise Shopper Payouts, instant cashouts to an external debit card**

The fee for an instant cashout to an external debit card depends on the shopper's level and recent cashouts:

| Line | Shopper level | Instant cashouts in the last 3 months | Fee charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Full-Service Shopper Diamond | none | no fee (0.00) |
| 2 | Full-Service Shopper Gold | none | half (a factor of 0.5, that is 50 percent) of the plan's instant cashout fee, rounded to the cent |
| 3 | any other shopper, or any shopper with one or more instant cashouts in the last 3 months | — | the plan's instant cashout fee |

The fee is the one taken from the balance on top of the amount sent and booked as its own fee entry beside the cashout.

**Definitions.**
- *The plan's instant cashout fee* is the instant cashout fee listed for the payout plan the account holds.
- *Instant cashouts in the last 3 months* are the instant cashout entries booked on the payout account fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the cashout. A single such entry takes the shopper off lines 1 and 2.
- *Shopper level* is the level on the shopper's contractor account. Shopper levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond.

**Matrix of combinations.**

| Level | No instant cashout in the last 3 months | One or more in the last 3 months |
|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver | plan's fee | plan's fee |
| Full-Service Shopper Gold | half the plan's fee | plan's fee |
| Full-Service Shopper Platinum, Full-Service Shopper Diamond | 0.00 | plan's fee |

**Illustrations (hypothetical fee figure).** Take an invented plan fee of 0.90.
- A Full-Service Shopper Gold shopper whose last instant cashout was booked 3 whole months and two days before today: no instant cashout in the last 3 months, fee half of 0.90, which is 0.45.
- The same shopper with an instant cashout booked 2 months ago: fee 0.90.
- A Full-Service Shopper Diamond shopper with no instant cashout in the last 3 months: fee 0.00.
